items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: Was that Jimmy Brown used to play with Manuel Perez?

ctx.x: Any type of band he could play with. Yeah. He played with a cab a long, long time. And he jumped from cab and went with a other band. Albert could play any type of music. Yeah, that's right. Well, that's what made him actually good. Played with a six-piece band, or he could play with a sixteen-piece band.
Were there any of the other old-time players I even remember? Was that Jimmy Brown used to play with Manuel Perez? What was he like? Do you remember? Was it his... That was the...
Was he playing with Jimmy Brown?
